video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.02.2026

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Peyton Watson's early training camp performance
quotes.excerpt: I'd say if I give you a one-word answer it would be activity.
quotes.quote: Peyton Watson is adapting to what we are doing. He is still in the learning phase, learning what we are doing. If I give you a one-word answer it would be activity. He looks like one of those guys that is super active on both sides of the ball.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says Peyton Watson is still in the learning phase of training camp but highlighted his activity on both sides of the ball as his standout trait so far.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Lauri Markkanen's physical and skill transformation
quotes.excerpt: He can do much more damage in the paint, whether it's post-ups or drives.
quotes.quote: I felt like he was pigeonholed into just being a shooting four-man. I think he has transformed his body where he's got the perimeter skill, but now he's at 250, 255 pounds, he can do much more damage in the paint, whether it's post-ups or drives. I've noticed his offensive rebounding prowess so far in camp. Definitely a transformation there, definitely not the same player.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says Lauri Markkanen has undergone a transformation. He is now playing at 250 to 255 pounds and is doing much more damage in the paint while maintaining his perimeter skills.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the team's emphasis on sports science and conditioning
quotes.excerpt: We've invested heavily into sports science. They lead us.
quotes.quote: It's a big part of our strategy for training camp and leading up to the first regular season game. The periodization that goes with that in-season is something we talk about a lot. We've invested heavily into sports science. They lead us. I obviously have to collaborate with them, but it's a big part of it in today's NBA, especially with the increase in intensity.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavaliers are leaning heavily into sports science and periodization this season to manage the increased intensity of the modern NBA schedule.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Jalen Tyson's strong start to training camp
quotes.excerpt: He has been one of the better players in camp so far.
quotes.quote: Jalen Tyson has been one of the better players in camp so far. I'm absolutely thrilled where he is right now. We know the worker he is, he's an elite worker. He's prepared. Obviously the shooting piece, he's shooting the heck out of it, but I've loved his defensive intensity so far.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Tyson is off to a strong start in training camp. Kenny Atkinson says he is thrilled with his progress, specifically noting his defensive intensity and elite shooting ability.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Evan Mobley's growth as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: It was almost by default Evan had to be more of a playmaker.
quotes.quote: I think he did take big steps in the playoffs. What happened in the playoffs last year, they took away Donovan Mitchell and James Harden or tried to take away and it was almost by default Evan had to be more of a playmaker. We ran a lot of those inverted pick-and-rolls with him, we let him bring the ball up because they were pressuring our two stars. I just think it's a natural evolution.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson views Evan Mobley taking on more playmaking duties as a natural evolution for his game after the playoffs forced him into a larger role.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the need for more playmakers beyond the stars
quotes.excerpt: We need more playmakers besides him and Donovan Mitchell.
quotes.quote: The other thing what I've learned from the playoffs is like we need more playmakers besides him and Donovan Mitchell. We have to encourage the Jalen Tysons, the Payton Watsons, our role players to be more aggressive if that makes sense.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the biggest lesson from the playoffs is that the Cavaliers need more playmakers beyond Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley, and he wants role players to be more aggressive.
